decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, Cobalt savings earn an extra 0.5 points on balances up to $50,000. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 1%, up to $5 cash back. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9.
